'''Khoris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He fought in the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]] during the [[Galactic War]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] aboard the [[Kuat Defensive Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Khoris appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' expansion, added to the game with Update 2.6.
